basics.name: Yihui Wang
basics.summary: Undergraduate student in Software Engineering at Hefei University of Technology. Remote research intern at NUS NExT++ Research Centre, supervised by Dr. Yonghui Yang and Prof. Tat-Seng Chua. Research interests include LLM safety & alignment, robust deepfake detection, and interpretability. CCPC National Gold Medalist. National Scholarship recipient.

projects.name: LLM Deep Safety Alignment: BEACON
projects.description: NUS NExT++ Research Centre. First Author, targeting ICLR 2027.
highlights: Quantified belief-behavior gap: internal probes >95% accuracy, yet compliance surges from <2% to >50%
Proposed BEACON: token-wise consistency losses cut adversarial success rate from >50% to ≤5% across four models

projects.name: S³: Suppressing Method-Specific Shortcuts for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
projects.description: NUS NExT++ Research Centre. First Author, ACM MM 2026 (CCF-A, Under Review).
highlights: Identified root cause of cross-domain failure: detectors learn forgery method, not forgery presence
Designed NSP (gradient projection) and NAE (plug-in inference module); cross-domain AUC gain 10× in-domain cost

projects.name: NeVA: Controllable Value Alignment in LLMs via Neuron-Level Editing
projects.description: NUS NExT++ Research Centre. Co-first Author, WWW 2026 (CCF-A, Under Review).
highlights: Locates and edits sparse neuron subsets governing specific value outputs in LLMs/LVLMs
Enables fine-grained value alignment without parameter updates

projects.name: Multi-dimensional Time Series Feature Alignment and Temporal Prediction Method Optimization
projects.description: Science-Education Integration Project Extension, Hefei University of Technology
highlights: Research on encoding methods and modeling based on multi-dimensional temporal features
Research on inference prediction optimization algorithms based on eliminating feature Hamming distance

projects.name: Power Battery Status Measurement System Based on Large Model Time Series Analysis in V2G Context
projects.description: Anhui Province Local Standard Plan Project
highlights: Research on power battery health prediction algorithm based on charge-discharge cycle characteristics
Participated in the development of new energy vehicle power battery status measurement and management system
